checks.title: Odd cylinders are on the right and numbering starts at the rear (looking forward from the accessory end)

source.where: A-1-1 (PDF p.13) section 1-6: front, rear, left and right refer to the engine as viewed by the mechanic facing the accessory end; section 1-7: cylinders are numbered starting from the rear, odd numbers on the right and even on the left

A-4-1 (PDF p.21) Figure A-4-1 Cylinder Numbering Diagram: 1, 3, 5 on one side from the bottom of the plan view, 2, 4, 6 on the other

forward.locator: cad_pipeline/gtsio_layout.py docstring: Z runs aft to forward (checked by frame-forward-is-plus-z)

accepted.reason: Reported on 19 Oct 2026 and not fixed here (B3 does not change the motion). The odd cylinders extend +X, which in the model's right-handed frame with +Z forward and +Y up is the LEFT side looking forward (right = forward x up = -X); the manual puts Nos. 1, 3 and 5 on the right. Numbering from the rear is correct. The model is therefore a left-right mirror of the manual's layout. Mirroring it (odd cylinders to -X, crank direction reversed) keeps the firing order, because the order is set by the crank pins and bank sides together (see tdc-vs-crank-pins and the mirror-image test in scripts/test_constraints.py).
accepted.ref: PR for plan item B3 (the motion belongs to the viewer and rig owners)

checks.title: The crank turns the way the manual implies: counterclockwise looking forward (derived from the propeller; not stated by the manual)

source.where: C-3-2 (PDF p.152): Propeller Shaft Rotation (Looking Forward) Clockwise*; the footnote says 'direction of rotation facing engine drive pad', which for the propeller flange would be the opposite view, so this reading assumes the explicit words 'Looking Forward'
A-3-2 (PDF p.17) item 4 and Figure A-4-8 (PDF p.25): crankshaft front splines drive the quill shaft, which turns the propeller shaft drive gear (24), which meshes with the propeller shaft gear (25)

checks.unknown: Not judged: X-30045A states no crankshaft rotation (searched the text for rotation, clockwise, direction of rotation, viewed from; C-3-2 and C-3-3 give only the propeller and accessory-drive rotations, each 'facing engine drive pad'). The one derivation that uses an explicit viewpoint is the propeller's: clockwise 'looking forward' through one external mesh makes the crank counterclockwise looking forward, the opposite of the model. A second derivation from the magnetos (Clockwise*, 1.5:1 through two external meshes, so the crank's sense) gives the model's direction if 'facing engine drive pad' means looking forward from the accessory end, and the opposite if it means looking aft; the manual does not say which, and the propeller line carries the same footnote with the opposite natural reading. The two derivations disagree, so the absolute direction stays unresolved until a source states it (the operator's handbook for the -H, X-30129 per the manual's section 1-5 list of related publications, is the likely one). The related IO-520 manual lists firing order 1-6-3-2-5-4, the reverse of 1-4-5-2-3-6, which fits a geared engine turning the opposite way to a direct-drive one, but it is a different engine and is not evidence.
